translations.web: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;
translations.bsb: ‘Never again will they hunger, and never will they thirst; nor will the sun beat down upon them, nor any scorching heat.’
translations.kjv: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
translations.asv: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun strike upon them, nor any heat:
